events.verdict: {Observable in enhanced video} Barnes (DAL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Gallinari (LAC) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Barnes' (DAL) driving shot attempt.
Harris (LAC) loses control of the ball on his own.
LLB shows Barea (DAL) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Bradley (LAC) that does not affect his SQBR.
During the follow through on his shot attempt, Bradley (LAC) brings his arm down and makes incidental contact to Barea's (DAL) head.
Barea (DAL) wraps his left arm around Bradley's (LAC) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Barea (DAL) steps inside the arc prior to the release of the shot attempt.
Harrell (LAC) takes longer than 10 seconds to shoot his free throw.
Jordan (DAL) makes contact with Harrell's (LAC) arm and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Gallinari (LAC) makes marginal contact with Barnes (DAL) that does not affect his FOM.
Jordan (DAL) and Harrell (LAC) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Bradley (LAC) and Matthews (DAL) make incidental foot to foot contact with one another off ball.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) legally contests Barnes' (DAL) shot attempt.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) makes contact to Jordan's (DAL) arm, but he is able to continue through the contact and attempt the shot near the rim.
Gallinari (LAC) is already in Finney-Smith's (DAL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Gallinari (LAC) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Barnes' (DAL) driving shot attempt.
Harris (LAC) makes contact with Finney-Smith's (DAL) hand during the follow-through on his shot near the rim but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Harrell (LAC) is already in Finney-Smith's (DAL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Jordan (DAL) cleanly steals the ball from Williams (LAC).
Williams (LAC) commits a take foul on Jordan (DAL).
Harrell (LAC) engages with Matthews (DAL) but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Williams (LAC) is already in Matthews' (DAL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Smith Jr. (DAL) legally contests Harris' (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Matthews (DAL) and Harrell (LAC) make incidental contact with one another during rebounding.
Harris (LAC) does not dislodge Matthews (DAL) from his legally obtained position as they come around the screen.
The replay shown shows Smith Jr. (DAL) cleanly blocks Harris' (LAC) shot attempt. After making contact with the ball Smith Jr. makes incidental "high-five" contact with Harris' hand.
Bradley (LAC) commits a take foul on Smith Jr. (DAL).
Matthews (DAL) legally contests Williams' (LAC) shot attempt.
